$comment: Maps a Still release version to the work it carries, so a reader can tell which
build contains which journey. The published artifact is the GitHub tag archive
of Jongtae/Still, consumed by scripts/install.sh and by this repository's own
Formula/agentos.rb. No Still release is published yet; v0.1.0 is the first.
Releases v1.0.4-v1.4.1 belong to the private predecessor Jongtae/agentos and
they are not Still releases. See docs/release.en.md.

published.carries: First Still release, restarted at 0.1.0 from the predecessor's in-tree 1.4.2; milestone v0.1.0 (#4, #45, #46, #48, #51). It carries the predecessor source imported on 2026-10-17 and the repository transition: public entry points, installer and development references point at Jongtae/Still, the Homebrew formula lives in this repository (brew tap jongtae/still https://github.com/Jongtae/Still), and the agentos command, data directory and AGENTOS_* variables are kept for compatibility. It also carries the fixes merged before preparation: WebKit process start before the first navigation deadline (#5), closing a disconnected web client without replaying (#6), the procedure-library replacement message (#7), a pinned turn clock in Work regression tests (#9), recovered steps told apart from unresolved failures (#14), the PR-body reuse review guide (#59), an incomplete calendar request handed to the AI worker (#63), no receive failure reported for one Telegram connection reset (#65), and the owner-model upkeep tests kept on their Works' clock (#67).
published.observed: Published by the release workflow after owner approval. The served tag archive SHA-256 was measured twice and matched; Homebrew formula PR https://github.com/Jongtae/Still/pull/72 merged after its macOS formula install and brew test passed. The owner's installed upgrade was observed on 2026-10-18 on macOS (Homebrew at /opt/homebrew): the first `brew install jongtae/still/agentos` stopped because the predecessor tap's formula of the same name was still tapped; after `brew uninstall agentos` and `brew untap jongtae/agentos` (docs/QUICKSTART.md), it installed `agentos 0.1.0` (`brew list --versions agentos`), and `agentos start` kept the existing data directory, reported the codex sign-in, the model and its tool calls and Judgment AI as checked, and served http://127.0.0.1:8787/. The owner did not run `brew test` or `scripts/quickstart_install_check.py`, and did not observe a background-service restart; two family instances were not reachable at that start.
published.not_claimed: No install of this tag archive was observed before publication; the publish workflow's macOS brew install/brew test and the installer smoke run only after the tag exists, and the owner's own upgrade is not yet recorded. Installs from the predecessor's Jongtae/homebrew-agentos tap are not moved to this tap by this release. Tests and CI do not prove live external integrations, model-dependent behavior or a background service surviving a restart.

published.carries: Minor release after v0.1.0; milestone v0.2.0 (#258, #262, #271) and everything merged to main since v0.1.0. New for the owner: work mode, an owner-switched mode in which nothing a Work produced is sent out and no undeclared destination is reached (#208); owner-declared intranet destinations admitted by the private-address guards, with every DNS answer of a declared API host checked and pinned and a code run's exact port checked (#209); Claude Code and Codex run through Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry or Azure OpenAI (#211); Memory kept as append + invalidate, with the upkeep ending rows by id and dated facts ending (#220); every reader given the owner's earlier words for the request and the whole owner profile (#221, #217); working lessons kept in one bounded, revisable notes document (#19); held values found in outbound tool text shown in the information-use audit (#167); a worker-drafted connection disconnect the owner confirms (#183); calendar requests through the worker draft tools with the exact-preview approval kept (#22); analysis-method skills and bounded header reads (#32); a bounded load-more for lazy lists in browser reads (#11); an offer to start Still at login at the end of first setup (#105); independent public reads of one turn run at the same time (#16); company tools through the owner's own local MCP servers, with the Codex server keeping its own HOME and PATH and Claude Code turns started in the default permission mode so Still decides each call (#210); and typing on the phone keyboard straight into the Mac login window from the phone sign-in page (#293). Judgment reads owner acts and situations in context instead of keyword rules (#170, #172, #173, #174). Secret handling: a retired secret is never recalled and the early plan's reads are audited, also when a Work parks or the plan is asked again (#258, #275, #279); exports redact JSON-escaped secrets and rebuild the search index (#271). Fixes include the Telegram Bot API transport on httpx2 and replies queued while Telegram is unreachable (#121, #123), usable Google credentials through renewal failures and write 401s (#8, #246), decoded Gmail bodies (#150), browser typing, press and stop fixes (#12, #102, #103, #244), the iPhone profile token (#13), non-ASCII case folding in result search (#203), an FTS5 statement re-prepared after a concurrent schema change (#262), locale catalog fixes (#10, #235), the phone sign-in link message saying how its session ended and the prompt dropping its buttons while the phone link drives the window (#255), and outbound audit records only after a transport hand-off (#233).
published.observed: Tagged, released and measured by the release workflow after owner approval (run 40111986005): the served tag archive SHA-256 was measured twice and matched, and measured again twice outside the workflow on 2026-10-25 with the same value. The workflow then stopped at the Homebrew formula PR https://github.com/Jongtae/Still/pull/298, whose validate failed on a traceability test that did not allow the formula before this record (#301, fixed by #302); the owner merged #298 after its checks, including the macOS 15 and 26 (Apple silicon) formula install and brew test, passed on its updated head. A full re-run stops at the existing tag, so this record was written with scripts/dev/release.py record outside the workflow (#286). On an Intel MacBook the owner's Homebrew install did not complete (2026-10-25); the cause is not yet diagnosed, and CI has no Intel Homebrew install. The owner's own installed upgrade is not yet recorded.
published.not_claimed: No install of this tag archive was observed before publication; the publish workflow's macOS brew install/brew test and the installer smoke run only after the tag exists, and the owner's own upgrade is not yet recorded. Tests and CI do not prove live external integrations, model-dependent behavior or a background service surviving a restart. In particular, no live Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry or Azure OpenAI run, no live intranet destination, and no work-mode session on a company network is claimed by this release. No live company MCP server is claimed; #210 was observed locally without a model. The Mattermost and Slack surfaces (#213, #214) are not in it. Known open defects: four predecessor fixes not yet ported, including asking for the current location before using a fitting saved place (#201), and a desktop-only page cropped in the phone-sized login window (#254).

unpublished.why_no_commit: The future tagged main merge commit does not exist; no earlier source SHA can stand in for it.
unpublished.why_no_checksum: No v0.2.1 GitHub tag archive exists; its served SHA-256 must be measured only after publication.
unpublished.carries: Next development-source version after v0.2.0. This placeholder does not choose the next release's version or claim a new product capability; the release-preparation PR does.
